title: Local lifting families detect zero maps with Grothendieck coefficients
statement: Let X be a qcqs scheme and A a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let p:F→G be an epimorphism of A-valued small-etale sheaves, W a qcqs object of the small etale site, B,T objects of A, x:B→G(W), and g:B→T. Suppose that for every source map π:B′→B and every covering sieve R on W, if for every f:Z→W in R the map πx restricted to Z lifts through p(Z), then πg=0. Then g=0. No compatibility of the local lifts is required and no fixed source object is assumed projective.

source.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 1, local lifting for the hypercover computation; Stacks Tags 00WL and 01H0

proof.text: Restrict to the qcqs etale basis via its sheaf equivalence, preserving epimorphisms. Let Q be the pointwise image of p. For each finite cover C=(W_i→W), let L_C⊆G(W) be the pullback of ∏Q(W_i) along restriction to ∏G(W_i). Their distinct subobjects form a small directed poset under cover refinement, by well-poweredness. The union L is a subsheaf of G: for a fixed finite basis cover W_i→W, its matching object is the kernel of the difference of the two restriction maps from ∏L(W_i) to the finite product of G on overlaps. By AB5 this is the filtered colimit of the kernels obtained by replacing L(W_i) by L_{C_i}(W_i), indexed by finite tuples of covers. Glue each such matching kernel in G and compose the covers C_i to get its factorization through L_C(W). The colimit universal property gives the inverse matching map. No arbitrary source is assumed to factor through a stage of a union. It contains the image of p, so p being epic forces L=G.

Pull this filtered union back along x. AB5 gives a filtered family B_C⊆B with union B. Pull back the finite product of image epimorphisms F(W_i)→Q(W_i) to obtain an epimorphism P_C→B_C. The composites P_C→B have lifts on the chosen covers and hence on their generated covering sieves.

The hypothesis kills g on each P_C. Cancel the epimorphism to B_C and use the union B_C=B to obtain g=0. Empty W is covered by the empty family, whose zero lifts test π=id_B; zero source and zero coefficients are immediate.

proof_origin.place: Agent-written categorical coefficient generalization of the local image and local primitive arguments in Stacks Tags 00WL and 01H0. Those sources themselves concern set-valued and abelian sheaves, respectively. Finite matching diagrams and AB5 provide the general-coefficient argument recorded here.

lean.statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_locally_liftable_maps
    {F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A} (p : F ⟶ G) [Epi p]
    (W : X.Etale) [CompactSpace W.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace W.left]
    (B T : A) (x : B ⟶ G.obj.obj (op W)) (g : B ⟶ T)
    (hkill : ∀ (B' : A) (π : B' ⟶ B) (R : Sieve W), R ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W →
      (∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), R f →
        ∃ l : B' ⟶ F.obj.obj (op Z), l ≫ p.hom.app (op Z) = π ≫ x ≫ G.obj.map f.op) →
      π ≫ g = 0) : g = 0
